disposition_reason: Market survey of fresh button mushrooms (Agaricus bisporus, n = 3 per market) from 15 local vegetable markets in 13 districts of Uttarakhand, India, analysed for Cd, Cr, Cu, Fe, Pb, Mn, Ni and Zn by AAS; per-market means in Table 2.

study.design: Cross-sectional market survey across plain and hill districts
study.origin: Grown locally in Uttarakhand (growers using wheat straw, manure and casing soil, as described)
study.market: 15 local vegetable markets in 13 districts of Uttarakhand State, India
lod: Instrument LOD (µg/L): Cd 3, Cr 4, Cu 4, Fe 5, Pb 20, Mn 3, Ni 10, Zn 3
study.qa: Recovery stated as >98%; no reference material named; triplicate analyses
